wiggers.title: Interactive Wiggers Diagram
wiggers.desc: Explore the full cardiac cycle with an animated, interactive Wiggers diagram. Hover over phases to understand valve events, pressure curves, and common abnormalities.

ecgaxis.title: ECG Axis Trainer
ecgaxis.desc: Train your eye on ECG axis deviation. Randomized ECG strips with instant feedback — perfect for residents preparing for board exams or daily ward practice.
